note: Every organisation, place, person, figure and sentence in this file is invented. Hosts use the reserved .example top-level domain. Nothing here is, or is derived from, a real source.

cases.title: A company-history timeline
cases.rationale: Openings and expansions from 1958 and 1962 are history. They must not become signals today.

documents.title: A company-history timeline
documents.text: Our history. In 1958 the company opened a new plant in Hollis Bay, Ohio. In 1962 it expanded manufacturing capacity at its Winterhold, Indiana plant, employing 400 people.

cases.title: A site profile describing past expansions
cases.rationale: A site page that recounts a 1994 opening and a 2003 line is a profile, not an announcement.

documents.title: A site profile describing past expansions
documents.text: The Ashgrove Mill bakery, which opened in 1994, was expanded in 2003 with a $20 million new production line and now employs 310 people.

cases.title: CONTROL: a completed opening is not an active pursuit
cases.rationale: Whether to RECORD a completed opening as a signal is a lifecycle decision (D-R3). What must hold now is that it does not become an active opportunity.

documents.title: CONTROL: a completed opening is not an active pursuit
documents.text: Kestrelwood Dairy Cooperative today celebrated the opening of its new $90 million processing plant in Ashgrove Mill, Wisconsin. The plant began production in January 2027 and employs 85 people.

cases.title: A 2019 announcement republished in 2026
cases.rationale: The text carries its own dates (a 2019 archive, a 2021 opening). A republished archive page is not a new project, and a repair must compare the text's dates with the document's.

documents.title: A 2019 announcement republished in 2026
documents.text: Reprinted from our 2019 archive: Brindlemoor will build a new 250,000 square foot plant in Carrow Ridge, Tennessee, a $180 million investment creating 200 jobs, scheduled to open in 2021.
